question: For pure coal firing in the drop-tube validation of the ammonia co-firing reactor-network model, what is the relative error of the simulated NO concentration against the measured one?
rendered:
Based on the information in document 1, page 6, the simulation results and measurements for pure coal firing and for an NH3 blending ratio of 20% are summarized in Table 7.

|  | Test | Simulation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NO (ppm, 6%O2) | 880.09 | 719.55 |
|  |  |  |

The relative error of the simulated NO concentration against the measured one is calculated as:

((719.55 - 880.09) / 880.09) * 100% ≈ -18.3%

However, the relative error is not explicitly stated in the table, but it can be calculated using the given values.
